commit.message:
Verify exact Lean core transport across two fresh Linux runners

Keep transport tools separate from the unchanged module source inventory. Build Arctan before capturing the complete base, restore byte-identical nonstdlib artifacts on a fresh runner, and run actual private generic and Arctan import audits without a dependency-cache fallback. This checks transport only, not the complete numerical grids.

+name: Rotating exact core transfer
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: ['research/remaining-open-problems']
+    paths:
+      - '.github/workflows/rotating-core-transfer.yml'
+      - 'OpenProblems/SolitonClassification/ProductionTools/**'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  produce:
+    name: Build and archive one exact Linux core
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 120
+    env:
+      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
+      TOOLS: ${{ github.workspace }}/OpenProblems/SolitonClassification/ProductionTools/tools
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        working-directory: OpenProblems/SolitonClassification/ModuleProduction
+    outputs:
+      archive_sha256: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.archive_sha256 }}
+      base_lock_sha256: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.base_lock_sha256 }}
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - name: Set an isolated producer directory on this runner
+        run: printf 'TRANSFER=%s/rotating-core-production\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - name: Verify separate transport tools and unchanged core sources
+        run: python3 "$TOOLS/verify_production_tools.py" --package "$TOOLS/.." --project .
+      - uses: leanprover/lean-action@ba3fdfe5c4476c925da13bf11a005ddb47e47aee
+        with:
+          lake-package-directory: OpenProblems/SolitonClassification/ModuleProduction
+          build: 'true'
+          test: 'false'
+          lint: 'false'
+          use-mathlib-cache: 'true'
+          use-github-cache: 'false'
+      - name: Include the final endpoint proof's upstream Arctan dependency
+        run: lake build Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Complex.Arctan
+      - name: Fresh generic audit including private declarations
+        run: |
+          set -o pipefail
+          mkdir -p "$TRANSFER/evidence"
+          lake env lean SolitonClassification/Rotating/ModuleFullGenericAudit.lean | tee "$TRANSFER/evidence/generic-audit.log"
+          df -h "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$RUNNER_TEMP" | tee "$TRANSFER/evidence/disk-before-pack.txt"
+      - name: Capture the actual compiler and complete Linux library bytes
+        run: lake env python3 "$TOOLS/production_environment.py" --project . --output "$TRANSFER/environment"
+      - name: Pack all exact nonstdlib roots once
+        run: |
+          python3 "$TOOLS/production_core_artifact.py" pack \
+            --base-lock "$TRANSFER/environment/base_lock.json" \
+            --base-args "$TRANSFER/environment/base_args.json" \
+            --source-inventory ModuleProductionSourceInventory.json \
+            --archive "$TRANSFER/core.tar.xz" --revision "$GITHUB_SHA"
+          df -h "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$RUNNER_TEMP" | tee "$TRANSFER/evidence/disk-after-pack.txt"
+      - name: Bind downstream archive and lock hashes
+        id: identity
+        run: |
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          import json, os, re
+          from pathlib import Path
+          record = json.loads((Path(os.environ['TRANSFER']) / 'core.tar.xz.index.json').read_bytes())
+          assert record['status'] == 'checked' and record['revision'] == os.environ['GITHUB_SHA']
+          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
+              for name in ['archive_sha256', 'base_lock_sha256']:
+                  assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', record[name])
+                  stream.write(name + '=' + record[name] + '\n')
+          PY
+      - name: Recheck all source bytes
+        run: python3 "$TOOLS/verify_production_tools.py" --package "$TOOLS/.." --project .
+      - name: Transfer the complete exact core
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: rotating-core-full-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: |
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rotating-core-production/core.tar.xz
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rotating-core-production/core.tar.xz.index.json
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          compression-level: 0
+          retention-days: 30
+      - name: Preserve producer evidence
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: rotating-core-producer-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: |
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rotating-core-production/environment
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rotating-core-production/evidence
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rotating-core-production/core.tar.xz.index.json
+          if-no-files-found: warn
+          retention-days: 30
+
+  restore:
+    name: Restore on a fresh runner and audit real imports
+    needs: produce
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 90
+    env:
+      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
+      TOOLS: ${{ github.workspace }}/OpenProblems/SolitonClassification/ProductionTools/tools
+      CORE_SHA: ${{ needs.produce.outputs.archive_sha256 }}
+      LOCK_SHA: ${{ needs.produce.outputs.base_lock_sha256 }}
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        working-directory: OpenProblems/SolitonClassification/ModuleProduction
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - name: Set an isolated consumer directory on this runner
+        run: printf 'TRANSFER=%s/rotating-core-restoration\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+      - name: Verify tool/source bytes before any library is restored
+        run: python3 "$TOOLS/verify_production_tools.py" --package "$TOOLS/.." --project .
+      - name: Install only the pinned Lean toolchain, without a dependency cache
+        uses: leanprover/lean-action@ba3fdfe5c4476c925da13bf11a005ddb47e47aee
+        with:
+          lake-package-directory: OpenProblems/SolitonClassification/ModuleProduction
+          build: 'false'
+          test: 'false'
+          lint: 'false'
+          use-mathlib-cache: 'false'
+          use-github-cache: 'false'
+      - name: Confirm no local Lake dependency tree was created
+        run: |
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          from pathlib import Path
+          assert not Path('.lake').exists(), 'Restore job must not build or cache dependencies'
+          PY
+      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: rotating-core-full-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/rotating-core-download
+      - name: Restore exact core bytes into new isolated paths
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p "$TRANSFER/evidence"
+          df -h "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$RUNNER_TEMP" | tee "$TRANSFER/evidence/disk-before-restore.txt"
+          python3 "$TOOLS/production_core_artifact.py" restore \
+            --archive "$RUNNER_TEMP/rotating-core-download/core.tar.xz" \
+            --sha256 "$CORE_SHA" --revision "$GITHUB_SHA" --lean lean \
+            --output "$TRANSFER/restored"
+          df -h "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$RUNNER_TEMP" | tee "$TRANSFER/evidence/disk-after-restore.txt"
+      - name: Actual fresh generic private audit and Arctan import from restored roots
+        run: |
+          ulimit -c 0
+          python3 "$TOOLS/production_core_import_check.py" \
+            --restored "$TRANSFER/restored" --project . --output "$TRANSFER/import_check" \
+            --revision "$GITHUB_SHA" --archive-sha256 "$CORE_SHA" --base-lock-sha256 "$LOCK_SHA" \
+            --memory-mb 4096 --seconds 600
+      - name: Recheck source inventory and absence of a fallback dependency cache
+        run: |
+          python3 "$TOOLS/verify_production_tools.py" --package "$TOOLS/.." --project .
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          from pathlib import Path
+          assert not Path('.lake').exists(), 'No dependency rebuild/cache is permitted in this job'
+          PY
+      - name: Preserve actual restoration and import evidence
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: rotating-core-consumer-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: |
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rotating-core-restoration/restored/restore_receipt.json
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rotating-core-restoration/restored/base_args.json
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rotating-core-restoration/restored/base_lock.json
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rotating-core-restoration/restored/core-metadata.json
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rotating-core-restoration/import_check
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/rotating-core-restoration/evidence
+          if-no-files-found: warn
+          retention-days: 30

+Exact-core transfer source package
+
+This independent ProductionTools directory leaves ModuleProduction's frozen
+108-file inventory and 88 Lean sources unchanged. Four existing production
+helpers are copied byte-for-byte. New wrappers and a two-job workflow compose
+their actual checks; package preparation is not a new theorem or Linux run.
+
+Job one builds the 88-module core, explicitly builds the upstream Complex.Arctan
+dependency, performs a fresh private audit, captures actual Linux bytes and
+archives all locked nonstdlib roots. Job two is a distinct fresh runner with the
+same pinned Lean version. It obtains no Mathlib/Lake cache, restores exactly those
+bytes, and performs a fresh all-private generic audit plus a real Arctan import.
+The consumer uses only restored explicit LEAN_PATH roots and checks Lean's actual
+resolved dependencies and the full base before/after. Output is not an import root.
+
+The recent Linux pilot had about 6.02 GB of locked nonstdlib files, rather than
+the smaller Windows library layout. Separate workers avoid keeping the original
+and restored 6 GB copies on the same machine. Actual disk usage is logged; the
+8 GiB complete expanded TAR limit remains enforced. No universal fit or runtime
+bound is inferred from the earlier small fixture. No old 32-step numeric shard
+is compiled by this workflow, and no full 8000-step result is asserted.
+
+Actions artifacts expire after 30 days here. They are transport/test evidence,
+not a claim of permanent proof-source archival storage. Later complete-proof
+delivery must preserve its reproducible sources durably.
+
+Run Python with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 or -B: exact source-package verification
+rejects unexpected files, including stale __pycache__ artifacts. Verify with:
+  python -B tools/verify_production_tools.py --package . --project ../ModuleProduction
+The included workflow is intended for .github/workflows/rotating-core-transfer.yml
+without byte changes. It supports workflow_dispatch and narrowly scoped pushes
+on research/remaining-open-problems affecting this workflow or ProductionTools.
+It does not change the older 32-step numerical pilot's trigger paths.

+"""Prepare a new transport-only source package; never alter ModuleProduction."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import argparse, json
+import verify_production_tools as verifier
+
+TOOLS = ['production_core_artifact.py', 'production_compile_shard.py', 'production_artifact.py',
+         'production_environment.py', 'production_core_import_check.py',
+         'verify_production_tools.py', 'prepare_production_tools.py']
+
+
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument('--source-dir', type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument('--core-project', type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument('--workflow', type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
+    a = p.parse_args()
+    output = a.output.resolve()
+    protected = [a.source_dir.resolve(), a.core_project.resolve()]
+    if output.exists() or any(output.is_relative_to(r) or r.is_relative_to(output) for r in protected):
+        raise ValueError('Require a new source-package destination outside the protected sources')
+    for path in [a.output, *a.output.parents]:
+        if path.is_symlink() or (hasattr(path, 'is_junction') and path.is_junction()):
+            raise ValueError('Output link/junction forbidden')
+    inventory = (a.core_project/'ModuleProductionSourceInventory.json').read_bytes()
+    if verifier.digest(inventory) != verifier.CORE_SHA:
+        raise ValueError('Wrong unchanged core source inventory')
+    blobs = {'tools/'+name: (a.source_dir/name).read_bytes() for name in TOOLS}
+    for name, sha in verifier.FROZEN.items():
+        if verifier.digest(blobs['tools/'+name]) != sha:
+            raise ValueError('Frozen helper bytes differ: '+name)
+    blobs['workflow/rotating-core-transfer.yml'] = a.workflow.read_bytes()
+    blobs['.gitattributes'] = b'* -text\n'
+    blobs['Scope.txt'] = b'''Exact-core transfer source package
+
+This independent ProductionTools directory leaves ModuleProduction's frozen
+108-file inventory and 88 Lean sources unchanged. Four existing production
+helpers are copied byte-for-byte. New wrappers and a two-job workflow compose
+their actual checks; package preparation is not a new theorem or Linux run.
+
+Job one builds the 88-module core, explicitly builds the upstream Complex.Arctan
+dependency, performs a fresh private audit, captures actual Linux bytes and
+archives all locked nonstdlib roots. Job two is a distinct fresh runner with the
+same pinned Lean version. It obtains no Mathlib/Lake cache, restores exactly those
+bytes, and performs a fresh all-private generic audit plus a real Arctan import.
+The consumer uses only restored explicit LEAN_PATH roots and checks Lean's actual
+resolved dependencies and the full base before/after. Output is not an import root.
+
+The recent Linux pilot had about 6.02 GB of locked nonstdlib files, rather than
+the smaller Windows library layout. Separate workers avoid keeping the original
+and restored 6 GB copies on the same machine. Actual disk usage is logged; the
+8 GiB complete expanded TAR limit remains enforced. No universal fit or runtime
+bound is inferred from the earlier small fixture. No old 32-step numeric shard
+is compiled by this workflow, and no full 8000-step result is asserted.
+
+Actions artifacts expire after 30 days here. They are transport/test evidence,
+not a claim of permanent proof-source archival storage. Later complete-proof
+delivery must preserve its reproducible sources durably.
+
+Run Python with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 or -B: exact source-package verification
+rejects unexpected files, including stale __pycache__ artifacts. Verify with:
+  python -B tools/verify_production_tools.py --package . --project ../ModuleProduction
+The included workflow is intended for .github/workflows/rotating-core-transfer.yml
+without byte changes. It supports workflow_dispatch and narrowly scoped pushes
+on research/remaining-open-problems affecting this workflow or ProductionTools.
+It does not change the older 32-step numerical pilot's trigger paths.
+'''
+    records = {name: {'sha256': verifier.digest(raw), 'bytes': len(raw)} for name, raw in blobs.items()}
+    manifest = {'schema': 'rotating.production-tools-source.v1', 'source_only': True,
+                'core_inventory_sha256': verifier.CORE_SHA, 'frozen_tools': verifier.FROZEN,
+                'workflow_sha256': verifier.digest(blobs['workflow/rotating-core-transfer.yml']),
+                'files': records, 'full_certificate_proved': False,
+                'linux_two_job_transfer_executed_by_packaging': False}
+    output.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name, raw in blobs.items():
+        path = output/verifier.relative(name)
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_bytes(raw)
+    (output/'ProductionToolsInventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
+    if ((a.core_project/'ModuleProductionSourceInventory.json').read_bytes() != inventory
+            or any((a.source_dir/name).read_bytes() != blobs['tools/'+name] for name in TOOLS)
+            or a.workflow.read_bytes() != blobs['workflow/rotating-core-transfer.yml']):
+        raise ValueError('Source changed during preparation')
+    print('PREPARED_PRODUCTION_TOOLS='+verifier.verify(output, a.core_project))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Hash-checked transport of a complete finite shard and its actual build evidence.
+
+Unpacking verifies provenance, not Lean logic. A fresh downstream Lean import
+and transitive axiom audit are still required. No archive is a shooting proof.
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import io
+import json
+import lzma
+import tarfile
+import tempfile
+from production_compile_shard import (
+    SCHEMA, REPORT_SCHEMA, SIDE, atomic_json, confined, digest, module_file,
+    validate_manifest,
+)
+
+HEADER = 'rotating-archive.json'
+
+
+def validate_xz(path, expanded_limit):
+    """Require a complete single XZ stream, including footer/checksum.
+
+    tarfile can stop at TAR EOF without reading a truncated XZ footer.
+    Bound both decoder memory and streamed output; do not materialize the tar.
+    """
+    decoder = lzma.LZMADecompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_XZ, memlimit=256 * 1024 * 1024)
+    total = 0
+    try:
+        with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
+            while True:
+                chunk = stream.read(1024 * 1024) if decoder.needs_input else b''
+                if not chunk and decoder.needs_input:
+                    raise ValueError('Truncated XZ stream: missing complete footer')
+                total += len(decoder.decompress(chunk, max_length=1024 * 1024))
+                if total > expanded_limit:
+                    raise ValueError('XZ stream exceeds expanded-size budget')
+                if decoder.eof:
+                    if decoder.unused_data or stream.read(1):
+                        raise ValueError('Trailing/concatenated XZ data is forbidden')
+                    return
+    except lzma.LZMAError as error:
+        raise ValueError(f'Invalid XZ container: {error}') from error
+
+
+def sha(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def validate_bundle(read):
+    manifest_bytes = read('manifest.json')
+    report_bytes = read('compile_report.json')
+    lock_bytes = read('base_lock.json')
+    m, r, lock = map(json.loads, (manifest_bytes, report_bytes, lock_bytes))
+    modules = validate_manifest(m)
+    if (r.get('schema') != REPORT_SCHEMA or r.get('status') != 'checked'
+            or r.get('shard_kernel_checked') is not True or r.get('key') != m['key']
+            or r.get('manifest_sha256') != sha(manifest_bytes)
+            or r.get('base_lock_sha256') != sha(lock_bytes)
+            or lock.get('schema') != 'rotating.production-base.v1' or lock['lean'] != r.get('lean')):
+        raise ValueError('No matching completed kernel-build report and base lock')
+    names = [item['name'] for item in modules]
+    if [item['name'] for item in r['modules']] != names:
+        raise ValueError('Incomplete or reordered build evidence')
+    evidence = {item['name']: item for item in r['modules']}
+    required = {'manifest.json', 'compile_report.json', 'base_lock.json'}
+    attachments = {item['source']: item['sha256'] for item in m.get('attachments', [])}
+    if r.get('attachment_sha256', {}) != attachments:
+        raise ValueError('Checkpoint attachments differ from the build report')
+    for name, expected in attachments.items():
+        if sha(read(name)) != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f'Checkpoint attachment bytes changed: {name}')
+        required.add(name)
+    external = {}
+    for item in modules:
+        name = item['name']
+        record = evidence[name]
+        if (record.get('exit_code') != 0 or record.get('source_sha256') != item['sha256']
+                or record.get('imports_before') != record.get('imports_after')
+                or set(record['imports_before']) != set(['Init', *item['imports']])):
+            raise ValueError(f'Failed or inconsistent module evidence: {name}')
+        if sha(read(item['source'])) != item['sha256'] or sha(read(record['log'])) != record['log_sha256']:
+            raise ValueError(f'Source or log bytes changed: {name}')
+        if '' not in record['artifacts'] or set(record['artifacts']) != set(record['checked_artifacts']):
+            raise ValueError('Incomplete olean/sidecar set')
+        for suffix, expected in record['artifacts'].items():
+            if suffix not in SIDE:
+                raise ValueError('Unknown olean sidecar')
+            relative = 'checked_oleans/' + module_file(name) + suffix
+            if record['checked_artifacts'][suffix] != relative:
+                raise ValueError('Noncanonical checked artifact path')
+            data = read(relative)
+            if sha(data) != expected['sha256'] or len(data) != expected['bytes']:
+                raise ValueError(f'Changed compiled artifact: {relative}')
+            required.add(relative)
+        for dep, expected in record['imports_before'].items():
+            if dep in evidence:
+                if expected['artifacts'] != evidence[dep]['artifacts']:
+                    raise ValueError(f'Mixed generated versions: {name} -> {dep}')
+            else:
+                if dep in external and external[dep] != expected:
+                    raise ValueError(f'Mixed external import versions: {dep}')
+                # The same first-hit resolution as the compiler, independently
+                # matched to the pinned base lock's labels and file hashes.
+                relative = module_file(dep)
+                label = next((label for label in lock['root_order']
+                              if label + '/' + relative in lock['files']), None)
+                if label is None:
+                    raise ValueError(f'External dependency absent from lock: {dep}')
+                locked = {suffix: lock['files'][label + '/' + relative + suffix]
+                          for suffix in SIDE if label + '/' + relative + suffix in lock['files']}
+                if expected['artifacts'] != locked:
+                    raise ValueError(f'External import disagrees with base lock: {dep}')
+                external[dep] = expected
+        required.update((item['source'], record['log']))
+    audit = evidence[m['audit_module']]
+    if (audit.get('reused_verified') is not False or audit.get('audit_message_seen') is not True
+            or m['audit_marker'].encode() not in read(audit['log'])):
+        raise ValueError('Missing actual fresh final audit')
+    return m, r, required, external
+
+
+def pack(manifest_path, archive, revision):
+    root = manifest_path.resolve().parent
+    if manifest_path.name != 'manifest.json':
+        raise ValueError('Canonical manifest.json filename required')
+    read = lambda name: confined(root, name).read_bytes()
+    m, r, files, external = validate_bundle(read)
+    records = []
+    archive = archive.resolve()
+    archive.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=archive.parent, prefix='.rotating-', delete=False) as stream:
+        temporary = Path(stream.name)
+    try:
+        with tarfile.open(temporary, 'w:xz', preset=6) as tar:
+            for name in sorted(files):
+                data = read(name)
+                info = tarfile.TarInfo(name)
+                info.size, info.mode, info.mtime = len(data), 0o644, 0
+                tar.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(data))
+                records.append({'path': name, 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': sha(data)})
+            metadata = {'schema': 'rotating.production-artifact.v1', 'revision': revision,
+                        'key': m['key'], 'sign': m['sign'], 'start': m['start'], 'count': m['count'],
+                        'manifest_sha256': sha(read('manifest.json')),
+                        'report_sha256': sha(read('compile_report.json')),
+                        'base_lock_sha256': sha(read('base_lock.json')),
+                        'external_imports': external, 'files': records,
+                        'full_certificate_proved': False}
+            data = json.dumps(metadata, sort_keys=True).encode()
+            info = tarfile.TarInfo(HEADER)
+            info.size, info.mode, info.mtime = len(data), 0o644, 0
+            tar.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(data))
+        # Validate the bytes actually archived, closing the packer's read/write
+        # race with a source or log changing after the initial preflight.
+        validate_xz(temporary, sum(x['bytes'] for x in records) + 16 * 1024 * 1024)
+        with tarfile.open(temporary, 'r:xz') as check:
+            archived_read = lambda name: check.extractfile(name).read()
+            cm, cr, needed, ce = validate_bundle(archived_read)
+            if (needed != files or ce != external
+                    or sha(archived_read('manifest.json')) != metadata['manifest_sha256']
+                    or sha(archived_read('compile_report.json')) != metadata['report_sha256']
+                    or sha(archived_read('base_lock.json')) != metadata['base_lock_sha256']):
+                raise ValueError('Bundle changed while packing')
+        temporary.replace(archive)
+    finally:
+        if temporary.exists():
+            temporary.unlink()
+    result = dict(archive_sha256=digest(archive), bytes=archive.stat().st_size,
+                  unpacked_bytes=sum(x['bytes'] for x in records), files=len(records),
+                  key=m['key'], revision=revision)
+    atomic_json(Path(str(archive) + '.index.json'), result)
+    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
+
+
+def unpack(archive, output, revision, max_bytes):
+    root = output.resolve()
+    # Never overwrite a partly reviewed or unrelated directory.
+    if root.exists() and any(root.iterdir()):
+        raise ValueError('Unpack destination must be new or empty')
+    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    validate_xz(archive, max_bytes + 16 * 1024 * 1024)
+    with tarfile.open(archive, 'r:xz') as tar:
+        members = []
+        for member in tar:
+            members.append(member)
+            if len(members) > 10000:

+"""Verify the separate transport-only source package and unchanged core project."""
+from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
+import argparse, hashlib, json, re
+
+CORE_SHA = '2c252cf849e22e027ca2630b836e5227b8ff8390cf45f36a6b467db64580c924'
+FROZEN = {
+    'production_core_artifact.py': '1ead0d5ced187dbf2d9847f7b08ea7f7a1e8931fe88ce8461c284fa277c73ea6',
+    'production_compile_shard.py': 'f0abd2db3d6b8db32707d33e8ebb8a6aaee7da0c6f2332c9c4da8e931c64310b',
+    'production_artifact.py': 'ddb448165391a04ab1ffcd9e4b572f9945f29fab5e1fa6ec981adad4b56323b5',
+    'production_environment.py': 'e51d7452662a39353a774242c60873ca5099deaad75db04c7ae083b68a7b74ac',
+}
+
+
+def digest(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def relative(name):
+    p = PurePosixPath(name)
+    if (not re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+', name) or p.is_absolute()
+            or any(x in ('.', '..') for x in p.parts) or p.as_posix() != name):
+        raise ValueError('Unsafe package member')
+    return p
+
+
+def verify(package, project=None):
+    package = package.resolve()
+    raw = (package/'ProductionToolsInventory.json').read_bytes()
+    record = json.loads(raw)
+    if (record.get('schema') != 'rotating.production-tools-source.v1'
+            or record.get('source_only') is not True or record.get('full_certificate_proved') is not False
+            or record['core_inventory_sha256'] != CORE_SHA or record['frozen_tools'] != FROZEN):
+        raise ValueError('Wrong source-only transport package identity')
+    actual = set()
+    for p in package.rglob('*'):
+        if p.is_symlink() or not p.resolve().is_relative_to(package):
+            raise ValueError('Package link or escape')
+        if p.is_file():
+            actual.add(p.relative_to(package).as_posix())
+    if actual != set(record['files']) | {'ProductionToolsInventory.json'}:
+        raise ValueError('Unlisted/missing transport package file')
+    for name, expected in record['files'].items():
+        data = (package/relative(name)).read_bytes()
+        if len(data) != expected['bytes'] or digest(data) != expected['sha256']:
+            raise ValueError('Transport source bytes changed: '+name)
+        if '.olean' in name or name.endswith(('.dll', '.so', '.exe')):
+            raise ValueError('Source package contains compiled artifacts')
+    for name, expected in FROZEN.items():
+        if digest((package/'tools'/name).read_bytes()) != expected:
+            raise ValueError('A frozen production helper changed')
+    if digest((package/'workflow/rotating-core-transfer.yml').read_bytes()) != record['workflow_sha256']:
+        raise ValueError('Workflow copy changed')
+    if project is not None:
+        project = project.resolve()
+        inventory_raw = (project/'ModuleProductionSourceInventory.json').read_bytes()
+        if digest(inventory_raw) != CORE_SHA:
+            raise ValueError('The original 108-file core inventory changed')
+        inventory = json.loads(inventory_raw)
+        if len(inventory['files']) != 108 or len(inventory['topological_modules']) != 88:
+            raise ValueError('Wrong core inventory/module count')
+        for name, expected in inventory['files'].items():
+            path = project/relative(name)
+            if path.is_symlink() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(project):
+                raise ValueError('Core source link/escape')
+            data = path.read_bytes()
+            if len(data) != expected['bytes'] or digest(data) != expected['sha256']:
+                raise ValueError('Core source byte changed: '+name)
+        found = {p.relative_to(project).as_posix() for p in (project/'SolitonClassification').rglob('*.lean')}
+        if found != {m['source'] for m in inventory['topological_modules']}:
+            raise ValueError('Core source glob changed')
+    return digest(raw)
+
+
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    p.add_argument('--package', type=Path, required=True)
+    p.add_argument('--project', type=Path)
+    args = p.parse_args()
+    print('PRODUCTION_TOOLS_SOURCE_VERIFIED='+verify(args.package, args.project))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
